title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.6
subtitle: A cleaner identity and a more focused Pull to Resume.

highlights.title: One consistent Cloth NeXt identity
highlights.description: The refreshed mark now uses consistent clear space and dark-surface variants, with Welcome and What's New presented in a more compact window.

highlights.title: A compact clock-only Resume pill
highlights.description: The green Resume control now emerges cleanly from behind Bake while keeping the toolbar focused and compact.

highlights.title: Frame details appear when needed
highlights.description: Arm the pull gesture to see exactly which verified checkpoint frame will resume before you let go.
